apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.localizedDescription:
ByeTunes 🎵
Say goodbye to iTunes sync!
ByeTunes is a native iOS app that lets you inject music (MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV) and ringtones directly into your device's media library—without needing a computer connection for every sync. It communicates directly with the iOS media database, giving you the power to manage your music on your terms.
Features

Direct Music Injection: Add songs to your Apple Music library without a PC.
(DISABLED FOR NOW) Ringtone Manager: Inject custom ringtones (.m4r and .mp3 auto-conversion).
Playlist Support: Create and manage playlists on the fly.
No Computer Needed (after setup): Once paired, you're free!
Metadata Editing: Auto-fetched from iTunes or Deezer.

Compilation Instructions
To build ByeTunes yourself, you'll need a Mac with Xcode.
Prerequisites

Xcode: Version 15+ recommended.
iOS Device: Running iOS 16.0 or later.

External Libraries
ByeTunes relies on idevice (a libimobiledevice alternative) to talk to the iOS internal file system. These files are NOT included in this repository for licensing/size reasons.
To compile the app, you need to obtain these two files and place them in the MusicManager/ directory:

libidevice_ffi.a (Static Library)
idevice.h (Header File)

You can find idevice and compile it from here: https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice
If you don't have these files, the project will not compile.
Backend Configuration
ByeTunes talks to a backend for downloads and metadata. The app reads the backend address from MusicManager/Config.plist, which is not included in this repository.

Copy Config.example.plist to MusicManager/Config.plist.
Replace the placeholder value of ByeTunesApiUrl with the address of your own backend.

Without this file the app falls back to a local placeholder address and downloads will not work.
Build Steps

Install Rust:
    bash
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh

Add the ios Arch:
    bash
    rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios


Install Xcode Command Line Tools if you don't have it already installed:
    bash
    xcode-select --install


Clone the repo:
    bash
    git clone https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice


Set a deployment target:
    bash
    export IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=xx.x


Run the cargo build:
    bash
    cargo build --release --package idevice-ffi --target aarch64-apple-ios
Inside the idevice folder find: idevice.h and libidevice_ffi.a. Move them inside the project in Xcode, make sure you create Bridging-Header.h
Inside your Xcode project and make sure you add:


bash
    #import "idevice.h"
In Project Settings > Build Phases > Link Binary With Libraries, make sure libidevice_ffi.a is listed.
How to Use


LocalDevVPN:

Download LocalDevVPN from the App Store/Altstore PAL https://apps.apple.com/us/app/localdevvpn/id6755608044.
Open it and tap Connect, you will need an active connection to import the pairing file inside the app.



Pairing:

On first launch, you'll see an "Import Pairing File" screen.
You need to get a pairing file.
Download idevice_pair refer to https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice_pair .
Generate you pairing file.
Export it from your computer and Airdrop/Save it to your iPhone.
Import it into ByeTunes.



Add Music:

Tap "Add Songs" and select files from your Files app.
Hit "Inject to Device" and watch the magic happen.



Ringtones:

Go to the Ringtones tab, add your file, and inject!



Notes

Signed Apps: If you install this via a signing service (Signulous, AltStore, etc.), the app includes a fix (asCopy: true) to ensure file importing works correctly without crashing.
Backup: Always good to have a backup of your music library before messing with database injection!

License & Hosted Backend
The source code is licensed under the MIT License.
The official ByeTunes download/metadata server is a separate hosted service and is not covered by that license. You are welcome to fork, modify and share ByeTunes under the MIT License, but modified builds must run their own backend instead of using the official one. Linking to this repository's releases is preferred over re-uploading them. See BACKEND_TERMS.md for details.
Support & Bug Reporting
Found a bug? We'd love to fix it!

Report Issues: Open a ticket on GitHub Issues.
Join the Community: Chat with us on Discord.
Attach Debug Logs:
If you are experiencing injection failures, please use the Debug Options under delte library inside settings.
This includes a "Debug Logs" screen where you can copy the app logs.
Please attach these logs to your issue report—they help us solve problems much faster!

apps.localizedDescription:
This version contains YouTube Plus, Return YouTube Dislikes, DontEatMyContent and Open in Safari extension

Features:
- Download videos, audio (including audio track selection), thumbnails, posts, and profile pictures
- Copy video, comment, and post information
- Interface customization: Remove feed elements, reorder tabs, enable OLED mode, and as use Shorts-only mode

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you create videos using the app.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: YouTube needs bluetooth access to scan for nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Access to your network allows YouTube to discover and connect to devices such as your TV.
privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: This lets you add your own audio files to your videos.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you include audio with your videos and search using your voice.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Makes it easier for you to attach location information to your videos and live streams and allows for features such as improved recommendations and ads.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID is required to authenticate.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you upload media you've already created.

versions.localizedDescription:
YouTube Plus v6.0

YouTube Plus Player
- New built-in player for downloaded videos and for streaming videos straight from YouTube without downloading
- Queue, video quality selection, subtitles, audio tracks, ambient mode, SponsorBlock, sleep timer, Discord RPC, gestures, mini player, background playback, Picture-in-Picture and more
- Remembers playback progress and resumes where you left off
- Option to open videos in the YouTube Plus player instead of YouTube's

Downloads
- New Downloads tab with shared, separate and private sections
- Select multiple files and act on them at once
- Resume interrupted downloads
- Download whole playlists
- Download later action in the download menu
- Edit metadata before and after downloading
- Convert videos and songs before downloading or any time later
- Downloads keep running in the background
- Download sheet remembers the last selected post-download action and encoding preset
- Improved downloader engine with support for new YouTube versions

Parental control
- Passcode for YouTube and YouTube Plus settings, account switching and the tab bar menu
- Restricted mode
- External link blocking
- Watch history
- Daily limit and allowed hours
- Channel blocklist and allowlist

YouTube Player
- Improved speed controls in the player overlay
- Inverted fullscreen option in the player overlay
- Loop button in the player overlay
- Rearrange the tweak's buttons in the player overlay
- Option to disable Picture-in-Picture
- Added "Don't offer SharePlay" option
- Option to keep feed videos muted when pressing the volume buttons
- Sleep timer can stop playback after a chosen chapter
- Improved selection of quality, subtitles and audio tracks
- Set several preferred languages for audio tracks and subtitles
- Option to enable captions when the preferred audio track isn't available
- More options to hide buttons under the player and in the context menu
- Improved playback fix mechanism
- Fixed YouTube Premium downloads on sideloaded installs (requires a YouTube Premium subscription)

Feed & Shorts
- Hide sponsored videos in profiles, new Playables and other feed elements (see the Feed section)
- Hide the new ads in Shorts
- Improved hiding of unwanted elements
- Fixed Shorts auto-skip on newer versions

Tab bar
- Add playlists as tabs
- Improved tab editor, tabs can now be edited offline
- The Downloads tab no longer reappears on every launch

SponsorBlock
- Submit segments, vote on existing ones and change their categories
- View all sponsor segments from the SponsorBlock menu in the player overlay

Interface & Settings
- Liquid Glass support (enable in Interface settings)
- The keyboard always stays original regardless of the selected interface, except for the floating keyboard
- Removed the OLED keyboard on iOS 27 (no longer works on sideload)
- Fixed sheets not following the YouTube theme
- More options to hide navigation bar buttons
- All menus redesigned, improved search bar and Split View support on iPad
- License status and date in the tweak's settings
- Fixed random "Access denied" errors

Other
- Adapted for YouTube 21.43 and iPhone Duo: floating tab bar, new channel watermarks, OLED theme in the new feed
- Fixed playback issues
- Improved support for legacy versions
- Improved opening of videos from links
